retention_days.title: Retention Days
retention_days.description: Days of logs retained; 0 means retained indefinitely.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether a retention rule is configured at all.

interval_seconds.title: Interval Seconds
interval_seconds.description: How often a scheduled purge runs.

next_purge_at.title: Next Purge At
next_purge_at.description: When the next scheduled purge is due, ISO-8601 UTC; null when retention is unlimited.

last_purge_at.title: Last Purge At
last_purge_at.description: When the last purge finished, ISO-8601 UTC.

last_trigger.title: Last Trigger
last_trigger.description: What started the last purge: 'scheduled' or 'manual'.

last_reclaimed_bytes.title: Last Reclaimed Bytes
last_reclaimed_bytes.description: Disk space the last purge's compaction returned to the filesystem, in bytes.

last_duration_seconds.title: Last Duration Seconds
last_duration_seconds.description: How long the last purge took, in seconds.

last_error.title: Last Error
last_error.description: Why the last purge failed, or null if it succeeded.

last_compaction_error.title: Last Compaction Error
last_compaction_error.description: Why the last purge could not reclaim disk space. Reported apart from last_error: the records were still deleted.

running.title: Running
running.description: Whether a purge is running right now.

started_at.title: Started At
started_at.description: When this run started, ISO-8601 UTC.

phase.title: Phase
phase.description: 'deleting' while records are going, 'compacting' while the freed space is handed back to the disk.

deleted.title: Deleted
deleted.description: Records deleted so far in this run.

cutoff.title: Cutoff
cutoff.description: Records older than this timestamp are being deleted.

anyOf.title: PurgeProgress
anyOf.description: Live counters for a purge that is running right now.

progress.description: Live counters while a purge is running; null otherwise.

schema.title: PurgeStatusResponse
schema.description: The retention purge schedule, its last outcome, and any run in flight.

409.description: Log retention is unlimited, so there is nothing to purge
